text:
Everyone has a role in a horror movie. The question is: will you make it to the end?
Halloween is just around the corner, and you know what that means: time for another horror movie marathon. You know the tropes. You know the superstitions. And you’ve probably yelled at the screen, “HUWAG KANG PUMASOK DIYAN!”
Knowing the rules is one thing. But following them? That’s another story.
Step into iconic Filipino horror scenarios inspired by the movies that traumatized a generation. Every choice you make affects your survival and secretly reveals what kind of horror character you really are.
